t: r/AskLosAngeles on Reddit: Is it a good idea to buy a house in Los Angeles today if I can afford it?
Buying a Home in Los Angeles: From Saving For a Down Payment to Making an Offer
s: November 6, 2024 - Saving for a down payment is one of the most significant steps in your journey to homeownership in Los Angeles. Typically, you'll want to aim for a traditional 20% down payment, which can mean more than $192,000 on a home priced at $960,000. However, don't be discouraged—many lenders accept low down payment options of 10% or even less, so assess your financial situation to see what you can realistically save. If you're a first-time homebuyer, consider buying with an FHA loan, which requires only a 3.5% down payment for borrowers with a credit score of 580 or above.
